notes: From the official DiGiCo SD9 Datasheet (manufacturer PDF, digico.biz). Standard config ships with a single internal PSU (product code X-SD9-WS); an optional dual redundant PSU config (X-SD9-WS-2P) adds a second AC/IEC inlet, not itemized as a separate port here. Optional expansion interfaces (Waves SoundGrid card, Optocore interface with selectable HMA/OpticalCon/ST connectivity, MultiMode or SingleMode) are omitted as discrete ports because their connector depends on order configuration. AES/EBU ports are physically 3-pin XLR (2ch per connector, "8 x XLR Mic/Line, 2 x XLR AES/EBU In (4ch), 2 x XLR AES/EBU Out (4ch)" per datasheet) but are tagged with connector "aes3" rather than "xlr3" to distinguish digital AES3 from analog mic/line. MADI BNC I/O and Word Clock I/O are each listed by DiGiCo as a single "1 x ... I/O" line item but represent separate physical IN and OUT BNC jacks (the same "1 x" phrasing is used for the 3-jack MIDI In/Thru/Out set, confirming it counts interfaces, not physical jacks). No SDI grade applied to MADI/BNC since MADI is an audio protocol, not video SDI; no RJ45 grade applied to the Ethernet or MADI-EtherCon D-Rack ports since no Ethernet speed is stated (D-Rack ports carry proprietary MADI, not IP traffic). GPI/GPO jack wiring (mono TS vs dual-circuit TRS) is not specified by the datasheet; TS assumed. Power inlet connector (IEC C13/14) inferred from standard practice for a 208W/232VA device — the datasheet states only voltage/current, not connector type. The SD9 is a desktop/tabletop control-surface console (878x785x262mm, 36kg), not rack-mounted, so rackUnits is omitted.
